```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(PeakAnnoAgent)
```

## Command-Line Workflow

Export web-tool-ready peak and gene-list inputs:

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
Rscript scripts/peak_agent.R annotate \
  --peaks examples/data/example_peaks.bed \
  --out results/example_annotation \
  --methods webexport \
  --species mm10 \
  --prefix example

Rscript scripts/peak_agent.R enrich \
  --genes examples/data/example_cluster_genes.tsv \
  --out results/example_pathways \
  --methods metascape,export \
  --cluster-col Cluster \
  --gene-col SYMBOL \
  --prefix example
```

Create example manuscript-style figures:

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
Rscript scripts/peak_agent.R figures \
  --annotation examples/data/example_annotation.tsv \
  --enrichment examples/data/example_enrichment.tsv \
  --out results/example_figures \
  --prefix example
```

## Full Analysis

For a full analysis, select local and API-backed methods explicitly:

```{bash, eval = FALSE}
Rscript scripts/peak_agent.R enrich \
  --genes clusters.tsv \
  --universe universe.tsv \
  --out results/pathway \
  --methods clusterprofiler,kegg,reactome,msigdb,enrichr,gprofiler,metascape \
  --species mm10 \
  --cluster-col Cluster \
  --gene-col SYMBOL \
  --prefix experiment1
```
